issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for Course.addRating(stars:): The problem statement (task description) requires an instance method addRating(stars:) to be implemented on Course and the template declares an extension with a non-private func addRating(stars:). The solution implementation declares the method as private (private func addRating(stars: Int)). Declaring it private in the solution prevents code in other files (for example Client.main() which calls swiftCourse.addRating(...)) from calling it, causing a compilation error and preventing students from running the provided Client example.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Course.addRating(stars:) non-private so it can be called from other files in the module. For example, change 'private func addRating(stars: Int)' to 'func addRating(stars: Int)' (or 'public func' if external module access is desired). This aligns the solution with the template and problem instructions and allows Client.main() to call addRating without compilation errors.
